messages.author: d4bf6f2e6432e252
messages.subject: axis grid lines vs break
parts:
Hi,

With the code shown here below I obtain the attached figured.
I would like to get rid of the grid lines when x+0.5, that is at 1.5, 2.5 etc., where ther is no dpi data.
I could convert the hpi variable into a factor etc. but I guess there must be a way to do it with numerical vectors.

Thanks in advance for your help,

ggplot(tidy.data, aes(x = harvest, y = measurement)) +
geom_point(aes(group = rep, color = rep), size = 1) +
scale_x_continuous(name="dpi", limits=c(1,10), breaks=seq(1,10,1)) +
facet_wrap(c("treat"))

David

messages.author: ae74f688ab11311c
messages.subject: Re: axis grid lines vs break
parts:
Hi David, so really you want to remove the minor grid lines and just be left with the major ones at the integers of your x axis? Have you tried simply adding "+ theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())" to your ggplot?

Apologies if this is not what you mean.
Hefin
